title: 3.2.2b Lab — Plane as floor
description: Add a Plane below a Sphere to create a floor — combining two primitives in one scene.

steps.title: Create the floor Plane
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `floor = new Plane(0, -1, 0, 10, 10)` to place a 10×10 flat surface 1 unit below the origin.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Plane section for the constructor parameters.

steps.title: Give the floor a color
steps.instructions: Set `floor.color = '#444'` so the floor is visible against the background.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the color property.

steps.title: Add a Sphere above the floor
steps.instructions: Create a Sphere at `(0, 0.5, 0)` with radius 0.7 so it sits just above the floor. Give it a color.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section.

requirements.title: Sphere is created
requirements.description: A new Sphere is also in the scene.

requirements.title: Both shapes have colors
requirements.description: At least one .color assignment is present.
